context: Reference implementation: helper extraction for multi-condition filters and derived-value mappers.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates EpisodeDigests.java with the method, both nested records, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves digest rules
checklist.description: Includes only published, non-explicit episodes longer than 10 minutes; ageDays is whole days from publishedAt to LocalDate.now(clock); fresh means at most 7 days; encounter order is kept.

checklist.name: Extracts the mapping into a named helper
checklist.description: The age and label computation and EpisodeDigest construction live in a named method (for example toDigest(episode, today)); the map callback is a one-expression lambda or method reference, not a block lambda.

checklist.name: Names the eligibility predicate
checklist.description: The three-condition filter is a named method or named Predicate (for example isIncluded or this::isEligible) rather than an inline multi-line condition in the filter call.

checklist.name: No block lambdas anywhere
checklist.description: No callback body in the file uses braces or continues onto further lines; extracted helpers contain plain code rather than another block lambda.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, caching, parallelism, extra public API, or dependency changes.

metadata.reference_selection: Candidate for main promotion; classify from the isolated hosted run.
